Updated for the Dungeon Settlers game update DS_B.0.4.29 (Steam build 25846389). Core 0.4.0 stays inactive on this build, and character packs such as Frieren do not start with it.
Install Frieren 0.4.1 together with Core 0.4.1. Under BepInEx, Frieren 0.4.0 only loads with exactly Core 0.4.0.
Nothing else changes. The Core API stays at 1.4.0.
Tested in game under BepInEx and MelonLoader together with Frieren 0.4.1 and Extended Hotbar 1.0.2: loading, saving and loading again, and the save protection for a save with an unknown effect.
